newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Tadiran in talks to sell shares in unit.
newsitem.headline: Tadiran in talks to sell shares in unit.

text.p: Tadiran Ltd is negotiating with a foreign company to sell some shares in its subsidiary Tadiran Electrical Appliances Industries, Tadiran informed the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange.
Tadiran spokeswoman Dalia Rosen refused to comment on the news and said the company could not provide further details.
Analysts believe Tadiran is seeking an international firm that would become a strategic partner in its subsidiary, which makes refrigerators and air-conditioners for the Israeli market.
Officials at Tadiran Electrical Appliances could not be reached for comment.
The parent company Tadiran, Israel's largest electronics company, is also traded in New York.
Tadiran Ltd is a subsidiary of Koor Industries.

Benjamin Gaon, president of Koor and chairman of Tadiran Ltd and Israel Zamir, president of Tadiran and chairman of Tadiran Electrical Appliances, said the negotiations were part of Koor's policy of joining forces with leading international companies.
Other Koor subsidiaries have already formed strategic partnerships with companies like Sheraton, Henkel, Volvo and General Dynamics.
